name: Yami Koto
source:
It is a story about darkness existing since ancient times. It pierces four epochs from Heian to Taisho. Is there despair or hope beyond that darkness?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Japanese-style horror game.
translation:
这是一个讲述自远古以来便存在的黑暗的故事。它贯穿从平安时代到大正时代的四个时期。黑暗彼端等待着人们的，究竟是绝望还是希望？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]

日式恐怖游戏。
